enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Impact: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Maiming: This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, it does an additional +6d8 damage.
Armor-Piercing 21%: Passive: +21% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Insightful Doublestrike 7%: Passive: 7% Insight bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
